craft_notes: Sthāyin: swiftness. Rows: certainty lands fast. Read aloud: quick step.

lines: Who stares unblinking at his face in glass
knows himself, and soon. No ladder leads but That-ness.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ādarśe hi svamukham aviratam avalokayataḥ tatsvarūpaniścitiḥ acireṇaiva bhavet na cātra kaścit kramaḥ pradhānam ṛte tanmayībhāvāt
